title: ライティングベーシックス
subtitle: Writing Basics
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In Writing Basics, students will acquire English writing skills by studying and applying writing techniques at the sentence, paragraph, and essay levels. They will compose English writing according to the rules of style, formatting, and organization. They will become familiar with composition on a computer, and they will also study and make use of metalanguage applicable to English writing.
advice: This course is a basic English writing course. We will cover the following areas: (1) Parts of speech (2) Combining sentences into effective paragraphs (3) Constructing an essay (4) Mechanics (5) Formatting Students are required to actively participate in the class.
books: Textbook: Trio Writing 1 (Oxford) Reference books: none Reserved books: none
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and basic computer skills are required.

activityGoals.body: Create sentences while using expressions unique to English.
Understand the formatting and punctuation of English text.
Understand and use the metalanguage and grammar necessary for writing paragraphs in English.
Ability to compose English text on computer.

achievementLevels.ideal: -Students understand English sentence structure and grammar and can consistently apply these ideas to their original English writing. -Students can clearly express their ideas in paragraph- and essay-length English writing. -Students can appropriately apply the rules of style and formatting introduced in class to their English writing. -Students fully understand and use metalanguage and grammar associated with English writing. -Students can compose English text on their computer with few or no mistakes.
achievementLevels.standard: -Students exhibit some understanding of English sentence structure and grammar and can apply these ideas to their original English writing with some success. -Students can express their ideas in paragraph- and essay-length English writing to some extent. -Students can apply the rules of style and formatting introduced in class to their English writing to some degree. -Students generally understand and make some use of metalanguage and grammar associated with English writing. -Students can compose English text on their computer, although there are some mistakes.
